purpose: Teach: 顎/灸/セラピー/ブタ/歌劇/抱きしめ/アクセル/卓球

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの顎ヒゲ、お洒落ね
lines.en: Sho, your dad's stubble looks quite stylish, doesn't it?
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost conversational. Warm but not pushing. A mother noticing small things about the people she loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、おばあちゃんに灸してもらいたい
lines.en: Mom, I want Grandma to give me moxibustion.
lines.style: Direct, earnest request. No performance. The kind of serious-faced statement a quiet child makes when something is genuinely on his mind.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママはアロマセラピーに通ってるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your mom has been going to aroma therapy sessions lately.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact sharing. Not defensive, just quietly explaining what she does for herself. A parent being honest about their own life.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ブタの絵本好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I really like the pig picture book.
lines.style: Simple, genuine statement. No urgency. A child sharing something he knows is true about himself, direct and unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが宝塚歌劇のチケットを買ってきたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad brought home tickets to the Takarazuka Opera.
lines.style: Soft, almost delighted announcement. Not over-the-top, but there's lightness in it. A small surprising thing that's worth mentioning.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに抱きしめてもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad gave me a hug today.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. The statement is simple but there's tenderness in how he says it. A small moment that mattered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、アクセル軽く踏むよう気をつけてるって
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been careful about easing up on the accelerator lately.
lines.style: Gentle share, almost thoughtful. A parent noticing effort her partner is making. Warm acknowledgment without needing comment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、卓球の試合、勝ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I won my table tennis match.
lines.style: Quiet but genuine pride. Not boastful. The way a child who doesn't perform would say something he's earned. Small smile underneath the words.
